It's crafted from Ohio-grown soft red winter wheat and aged in American white oak barrels. The mature wheat whiskey is then transferred to Oloroso Sherry casks, where it acquires rich, nutty notes of black cherry, dark chocolate, and raisins. SPECIFICATIONS FORMAT 750 mL MINIMUM MATURATION TIME 5 Years ABV 50% (100 proof) MASH BILL Ohio Soft Red Winter Wheat CASK TYPES Toasted and Charred American White Oak Oloroso Sherry Casks
